game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Rope Line, a long fixed rope line: the avalanche scout must handle storm winds while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Vault: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the rope bridge.
theme: Frost Peaks – Rope Line: a long fixed rope line
core_gameplay_loop: In Rope Line, repeat each round: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the rope bridge. Each round, storm winds strike the rope bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the vault_keys value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rope bridge from storm winds in Rope Line: keep the vault_keys meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: vault_keys drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 67-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Key Vault
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Vault' (Week 8 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Rope Line'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault_keys changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm winds in Rope Line.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 67 seconds while vault_keys > 0.
